children.text: Bessemer is a decentralized partnership. Investors invest with full autonomy, conviction, and accountability across their own investments. The team you see here spans four continents, multiple sectors, and every stage from seed to IPO. Depth and autonomy are built into how our firm works.

filterHeaders.headline: Supporting India with a dedicated $350 million fund.
filterHeaders.subhead:
Innovation and entrepreneurship are not limited to any single city or country.
Since opening our India office 20 years ago, Bessemer has partnered with more than 80 startups across a wide range of company stages and sectors in India. Our second dedicated India fund brings $350 million of capital to founders in the region at the earliest stages and beyond.

filterHeaders.headline: Investing in Israel for over three decades.
filterHeaders.subhead: Local in Tel Aviv since 2007, with continuous investment activity in the region ever since. With more than $1 billion invested in Israel over the last decade, we have had the privilege of being the first venture investor in iconic Israeli companies such as Axonius, Fiverr, Habana, HiBob, Intucell, Melio, Wix, and others. Our local Tel Aviv team leads early-stage investments in Israel and collaborates with Bessemer investors globally.

filterHeaders.headline: Building with the founders defining Europe's next chapter.
filterHeaders.subhead:
London-based. Europe-wide. Globally connected.

Our European team operates from London with a mandate that spans the continent, from early-stage UK startups to category-defining companies across Germany, Switzerland, the Netherlands, and beyond. If you're building something ambitious in Europe, we want to hear about it.

result.headline: A tight-knit team of independent thinkers.

stageFilterHeaders.headline: To the next century.
stageFilterHeaders.subhead: Enduring companies aren’t built in a single stage. Our dedicated growth practice exists for founders who have proven the thesis and are now building the institution. Decades of experience. A clear view of what comes next.

stageFilterHeaders.headline: 62% of our investments are pre-revenue at the time of initial investment.*
stageFilterHeaders.subhead:
We’re early believers who invest in visionaries. It doesn’t stop there; we partner from concept through Series A and all stages of growth. Beyond the capital, we provide the complete support ecosystem seed-stage startups need to scale from MVP to market leader.

*62% of Bessemer Investments are pre-revenue as of 9/30/2025

result.subhead: We champion conviction over consensus, backing bold ideas grounded in honesty.
